data.name: Demon Hunter
data.description: You are well-versed in demonic lore. Gain Knowledge and combat bonuses vs. demons. You are well-versed in demonic lore. You gain a +2 bonus on Knowledge (planes) checks to know the powers and abilities of demons. You gain a +2 morale bonus on all attack rolls and a +2 morale bonus on caster level checks to penetrate spell resistance made against creatures with the demon subtype you recognize as demons.
